verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.discord.com (HTTP 200) that indexes the developer docs. Individual pages are served as Markdown (.md) and include a header pointing agents to the llms.txt index, and many doc URLs in the pack use .md variants. Missing for 10: no first-party or independent account of agents actually using these docs, and no machine-readable API spec (all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404).
